findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration, Terraform state, or version control history.

No kms_key_arn is specified for the Lambda function, so environment variables (which contain secrets) are only protected by the default AWS-managed key rather than a customer-managed key, weakening control over encryption at rest for sensitive data.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a Node.js runtime that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
